issues.jp_before: 明日[あした]の朝[あさ]、早[はや]く来[き]て窓[まど]を{開[あ]けとく|cs-teru}ね。
issues.problem: Distractor 開けてる is borderline acceptable ('I'll have the windows open').
issues.action: Replaced 開けてる with 開けなきゃ.

issues.jp_before: この図書館[としょかん]の本[ほん]は、読[よ]ん{じゃ|cs-nakya}いけないの？
issues.problem: Slot held only じゃ while distractors were whole words (would render 読ん読まなきゃ); 'not allowed to read books in a library' is an odd scenario.
issues.action: Rewrote as この雑誌は、図書館の外に{持ち出しちゃ}いけないの？ with whole-word distractors 持ち出さなきゃ / 持ち出しちゃう / 持ち出しとく.

issues.jp_before: {すいません|cs-sound}、ちょっと質問[しつもん]してもいいですか。
issues.problem: Distractor やっぱり makes a natural sentence ('Actually, may I ask...').

issues.problem: Distractor 忘れてた ('I'd left it on the train') fits the English.
